summary: Assist to Alamosa County with two rescue techs for an injured party on Ellingwood Point
responding_agency: Alpine Rescue Team, Alamosa County SAR
notes: Injury mechanism per Alamosa Citizen SLV Outdoor Report (week of Aug 5, 2024): hiker descended Ellingwood southwest approach, activated Garmin InReach SOS; found with a severely broken arm, pinned by a large boulder in steep terrain; ground + helo crews secured him for a National Guard helicopter hoist; flown to a Front Range hospital. Resolves the Miners/Journal "Ellingwood twice in recent weeks" mention (this mission, ~Aug 3-4, distinct from the 2024-07-26 overnight fall id 1415). ART mission 2024-093.
